info.title: Numo orderbook API
info.description: REST endpoints exposed by Numo's markets-service for dollar stablecoins. Real-time book, trades, and order streams are served over the WebSocket endpoint documented in the WebSocket streams reference.

get.description: Your orders in every status, newest first.

parameters.name: X-Numo-Auth
parameters.description: Base64url-encoded JSON auth frame {address, signature, nonce, issued_at, expiry}, signed with personal_sign over the order-history message. See the endpoint page for the exact message.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before value from the previous page, to page to older orders.

200.description: One page of the owner's orders, newest first

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or mismatched auth frame

409.description: Duplicate order, or an order on a future past its last trade time

422.description: A post-only order that would cross the book, or a future order the chain could not settle: its limit is outside the fill band (error starts fill_band:), its account is not under the MarginEngine, or reduce_only has nothing to reduce.

503.description: An order the venue cannot check right now: the account's custody could not be read, or, for a future, the index is stale or the band, the series or the account's manager could not be read. Nothing was placed. Retry shortly.

parameters.name: X-Numo-Auth
parameters.description: Base64url-encoded JSON auth frame {address, signature, nonce, issued_at, expiry}, signed with personal_sign over the order-history message. The same frame GET /orders accepts.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: The next_before value from the previous page, to page to older fills.

200.description: One page of the owner's fills, newest first

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired or mismatched auth frame

get.description: An account's futures positions and margin, read from chain.

parameters.name: subaccount_id
parameters.description: The subaccount to read, as a decimal integer.

400.description: subaccount_id missing or not a non-negative integer

post.description: Withdraws from a subaccount held by Matching with one signed action.

200.description: Submitted. receipt_status timeout means broadcast but not yet confirmed.

400.description: Malformed or off-policy request, or the subaccount is not deposited in Matching

401.description: The signature does not authorize the action

403.description: Matching records another owner for the subaccount

422.description: The executor refused it: the simulation reverted, and revert names the revert

429.description: A withdrawal for this owner is in progress, or more than five were requested in a minute

502.description: Outcome unknown: check the balance before signing another withdrawal

503.description: Withdrawals are not enabled, or the signature or owner could not be read

post.description: Opens and funds a trading account, or tops one up, with one signed action. The venue pays the gas.

200.description: Submitted. receipt_status timeout means broadcast but not yet confirmed; resubmit the same request for the outcome.

400.description: Invalid request or a failed chain check. error says what to do.

401.description: The signature does not authorize the action

422.description: The simulation reverted for a reason not listed under 400, and revert names it

202.description: The same signed deposit is already being submitted; status is pending. Read it later with GET /deposits/{action_hash}.

429.description: A deposit for this owner is in progress, more than three were requested in a minute, or six were submitted in the last hour (Retry-After)

502.description: Could not confirm whether the deposit was submitted

503.description: Deposits are not enabled, or paused: the venue's gas wallet is below its reserve, or the hour's sponsored gas budget is spent

get.description: A deposit's record, by the EIP-712 hash of its signed action.

503.description: Deposits are not enabled, or the record could not be read

parameters.name: order_id
parameters.description: The order_id returned when the order was created

200.description: Current status and fill snapshot for the order

post.summary: Cancel order by owner and nonce

401.description: The signature is missing or does not authorize the cancel

403.description: The order belongs to a protected order_id namespace

market.description: The market identifier: cNGN-USDC (spot), or <BASE>-<DDMONYY> for a future, for example cNGN-30NOV26. Always the canonical identifier, whichever alias the request used. This is the value to pass as symbol, market and ticker_id.

base_asset_symbol.description: The asset priced: cNGN on cNGN-USDC and cNGN-30NOV26.

quote_asset_symbol.description: The asset prices are quoted in: USDC.

expiry_timestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the market expires. Present on a future, where it is also the sub_id; omitted on cNGN-USDC.

display_name.description: Human-readable pair name. It equals the market identifier. Use market as the identifier; this is for display.

display_label.description: Unit of every price on the market.

tick_size.description: Smallest price increment. Order prices are normalized against it.

min_size.description: Smallest tradable size. Order amounts are normalized against it, and an amount below it normalizes to zero and is rejected.

contract_multiplier.description: 1 on spot. On a future, the base per contract: 1000000 on cNGN-30NOV26.

pricing_model.description: How the instrument's price relates to its underlying. All current markets are linear.

price_semantics.description: Interpretation of the raw price fields. Mirrors pricing_model.

display_price_kind.description: How a client should render the price. All current markets are direct.

display_semantics.description: Interpretation of the displayed price. Mirrors display_price_kind.

last_trade_timestamp.description: Unix seconds of the most recent fill.

order_entry_spec.description: Identifies the ui_intent contract the market accepts: cngn_usdc_spot_v1 on cNGN-USDC, an identity mapping: the engine order is the ui_intent. Omitted on futures, which take raw engine values only. The retired usdc_cngn_* specs are refused.

ui_price_unit.description: Unit of ui_intent.price. The same as engine_price_unit.

ui_size_unit.description: Unit of a size: cNGN amount on spot, 1,000 cNGN of notional on cNGN-30NOV26. On a future, one unit is 0.001 contract.

ui_side_meaning.description: What each side does in the base. On spot: BUY acquires cNGN and pays USDC; SELL delivers cNGN and receives USDC. On a future a BUY (long) gains when the base strengthens against USD, a SELL (short) when it weakens.
ui_side_meaning.example: BUY acquires cNGN and pays USDC; SELL delivers cNGN and receives USDC.

engine_price_unit.description: Unit of the raw price and limit_price fields.

engine_amount_unit.description: Unit of the raw desired_amount, filled_amount and size fields.

engine_side_policy.description: How ui_intent.side maps to the engine side. Always same_as_ui.

ui_size_to_engine.description: Size conversion formula. The identity; the signed amount is ui_size x amount_scale.

trade_module_address.description: The TradeModule an order for this market must name in action_json.module. Spot and the futures share it.

quote_asset_address.description: The USDC CashAsset: what spot is settled in, and what fees, margin and variation margin on a future are paid in.

margin_manager_address.description: The MarginEngine: the manager a trading account for this market must be under. Spot and the futures share it.

amount_scale.description: What one unit of size is signed as in action_json.data: 1e18 on spot (one cNGN), 1e15 on a future (0.001 contract, which is 1,000 cNGN on cNGN-30NOV26).

fill_band_enforced.description: Futures only, always true: the venue admits an order and fills it only inside the fill band, as the chain does.

fill_band_low.description: Futures only: the lowest price, in USDC per unit of the base, the chain accepts a fill at now. Omitted while the band cannot be read.

fill_band_high.description: Futures only: the highest price, in USDC per unit of the base, the chain accepts a fill at now. Omitted while the band cannot be read.

future.description: Futures only: the series' live state read from chain. Omitted on spot.

created_at.description: When the order was accepted onto the book.

TradeStats24h.description: Stats over the trailing 24 hours. Every field is omitted when nothing traded.

change.description: Last price minus the window's first traded price, in engine price units.

high.description: Highest price in the window, in USDC per cNGN.

last.description: Most recent engine price in the window.

low.description: Lowest price in the window, in USDC per cNGN.

volume.description: Summed fill size in cNGN, the base asset.

quote_volume.description: Summed fill notional (price x size) in USDC, the quote asset. Use this, not volume, for a USDC figure.

FutureMarketState.description: A future series as the chain has it. Prices are USDC per unit of the base, up to 18 decimal places (cNGN per USDC on the retired USDC-cNGN-30NOV26). An absent optional field could not be read: treat it as unknown, not as zero.

expiry_timestamp.description: Unix seconds the series expires and settles. Also its sub_id.

last_trade_time.description: Unix seconds after which no order is accepted and nothing fills. One hour before expiry.

listed.description: The series is listed on its FutureAsset.

trading_open.description: Whether the matcher crosses orders. Orders still rest while it is false.

trading_closed_reason.description: Why trading_open is false. Omitted while it is true.

mark_price.description: The mark variation margin is settled against.

index_price.description: The index the fill band is centred on.

band_width.description: The fill band's half-width as a fraction of the index: 0.1 is the index -/+ 10%. It narrows to 0.01 over the last 14 days before expiry.

band_status.description: ok when the band was read. index_stale: the index feed is past its heartbeat, so the chain refuses every fill and the venue refuses new orders. unreadable: the read failed.

contract_size_usdc.description: USDC notional of one contract. Only on the retired USDC-cNGN-30NOV26.

close_only.description: True on a series that is winding down and takes no new positions.

SpotUIIntent.description: The order in the units a UI displays: side in cNGN, price in USDC per cNGN to 10 decimal places, size in cNGN to 6. Since the cNGN-USDC orientation this equals engine_order; only the scale differs.

side.description: buy acquires cNGN and pays USDC; sell delivers cNGN and receives USDC. Equals the engine side.

price.description: Price in USDC per cNGN, to 10 decimal places. Equals the engine price.

size.description: Size in cNGN, to 6 decimal places. Equals the engine amount.

SpotContract.description: Present on cNGN-USDC. Restates the engine order at display scales.

engine_order.description: The order as the matching engine sees it: cNGN traded against the quote asset, at the engine's full scale.

price.description: Engine price in USDC per cNGN.

balance_delta.description: Balance change if the order fills completely, signed, to 6 decimal places. A buy of size S at price P is cngn +S and usdc -S x P; a sell is cngn -S and usdc +S x P.

order_entry_spec.description: Optional, cNGN-USDC only: cngn_usdc_spot_v1. Requires ui_intent. Omit both to submit raw engine values.

ui_intent.description: Optional, cNGN-USDC only. Requires order_entry_spec. Sets side, limit_price and desired_amount. If you also send those fields, they must match.

reduce_only.description: Futures only: the order may only shrink the account's position in the series. Refused on spot (400), and refused (422) when the account has no position or the order is on the same side as it. The matcher clamps each fill so it never crosses through zero.

post_only.description: Spot and futures: refuse the order if it would cross the book, and never let it be the taker once it rests.

signer_address.description: Must equal owner_address: a session key cannot cancel.

expiry.description: Unix seconds, in the future. Bounds how long the signature can be replayed.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature over Cancel(address owner,address signer,uint256 nonce,uint256 expiry) with the Matching domain.

trade_id.description: The trade this fill belongs to, as on GET /trades.

liquidity.description: taker when your order crossed the book, maker when it rested and was hit.

side.description: Your order's side: buy acquired cNGN and paid USDC. Equals spot_contract.ui_intent.side.

price.description: Price the fill executed at, in USDC per cNGN, at the engine's scale.

size.description: Size filled, in cNGN, at the engine's scale.

fee.description: What your order paid on the fill, in USDC. 0 for a maker fill; for a taker, the fee charged. Absent when not known.

tx_hash.description: The Base transaction that settled the fill. Absent for fills recorded before it was stored.

mark_price.description: Futures only: the mark the fill settled against, in the market's price unit: the mark in force when the fill's transaction ran. Absent on other markets and when the venue could not read it.

vm_cngn.description: The same on the retired USDC-cNGN-30NOV26, in cNGN.

vm_usdc.description: Futures only: the variation margin the fill settled at once, in USDC to your account (negative when paid): your side × the size in the base × (mark_price − price). Absent whenever mark_price is.

spot_contract.description: The fill at display scales: ui_intent.size is the cNGN that changed hands, ui_intent.price the USDC per cNGN it traded at, and balance_delta what the fill moved.

next_before.description: Pass as before to fetch older fills. Absent on the last page.

action.description: A Matching Action for the WithdrawalModule, signed with EIP-712 against the Matching domain.

subaccount_id.description: Base-10 subaccount id, deposited in Matching.

nonce.description: Base-10 uint256, unused by this owner in the WithdrawalModule.

data.description: abi.encode(address asset, uint256 amount): the wrapped asset, and the amount in the token's native decimals.

expiry.description: Unix seconds; in the future and at most one hour ahead.

owner.description: The subaccount's owner as Matching records it. Tokens are paid here.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature by signer: 65 bytes, or longer for an ERC-1271 wallet.

action.description: A Matching Action for the DepositModule, signed with EIP-712 against the Matching domain.

subaccount_id.description: Base-10. 0 opens a new account under the MarginEngine; otherwise your account to top up.

nonce.description: Base-10 uint256, unused by this owner in the DepositModule.

data.description: abi.encode(uint256 amount, address asset, address managerForNewAccount). See the page for accepted assets and minimums.

expiry.description: Unix seconds; in the future and at most one hour ahead.

owner.description: Your address: the tokens are pulled from here, and you own the account.

signature.description: EIP-712 signature by signer: 65 bytes, or longer for an ERC-1271 wallet.

permit.description: Optional EIP-2612 permit instead of an approve. USDC only.

value.description: Base-10, 6-decimal USDC base units; at least the deposit amount.

signature.description: 65-byte EIP-712 signature over USDC's Permit, by owner.

action_hash.description: EIP-712 hash of the signed action (Matching.getActionHash); the key for GET /deposits/{action_hash}.

subaccount_id.description: The account credited: your new account when subaccount_id was 0. Absent until the receipt is known.

asset.description: The wrapped asset credited: the cash asset (USDC) or the cNGN escrow.

amount.description: The deposit in the token, with 6 decimal places.

amount_units.description: The same amount in the token's 6-decimal base units, as signed.

credited_e18.description: What the account's balance of the asset rises by, at the ledger's 18 decimals.

amount_usdc.description: Same as amount; USDC deposits only.

credited_cash_e18.description: Same as credited_e18; USDC deposits only.

permit_tx_hash.description: The permit's transaction, when the deposit carried a permit and it was needed.

status.description: rejected: refused before anything was sent; the same request may be resubmitted.

permit_tx_hash.description: The permit's transaction, when the deposit carried a permit and it was needed.

revert.description: The revert the simulation hit, e.g. WERC_CannotBeNegative.

cancel_reason.description: Why the order was cancelled; absent otherwise.

cancelled_at.description: When the order was cancelled; absent otherwise.

filled_quote.description: USDC traded, to 6 decimal places. Absent when nothing filled.

next_before.description: Pass as before to fetch older orders. Absent on the last page.

IntegrationTicker.description: A spot market. Price fields are null when there is no value.

ticker_id.description: The market identifier. Pass it as ticker_id to the orderbook and trades endpoints.

target_currency.description: The asset prices are quoted in.

last_price.description: Most recent fill at any age, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

base_volume.description: base_currency traded in the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 6 decimal places.

target_volume.description: target_currency traded in the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 18 decimal places.

bid.description: Best bid, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

ask.description: Best ask, rounded up to 10 decimal places.

high.description: Highest fill in the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

low.description: Lowest fill in the trailing 24 hours, rounded down to 10 decimal places.

IntegrationLevel.description: [price, quantity]. Price to 10 decimal places (bids rounded down, asks up), quantity to 6 rounded down.

price.description: target_currency per base_currency, to 10 decimal places.

type.description: The taker's side: buy means the taker bought base_currency.

next_before_trade_id.description: Pass as before_trade_id for older trades. Absent on the last page.

PositionsResponse.description: Read futures and futures_account. Other keys are reserved.

futures.description: One entry per listed series the account holds. Empty when the account is flat in every series.

positions.description: Reserved. Not part of the documented response; it may be absent.

accounts.description: Reserved. Not part of the documented response; it may be absent.

FuturePosition.description: One futures position. An absent field is unknown, not zero.

sub_id.description: The series' sub id: its expiry, in unix seconds.

status.description: trading before last_trade_time; closing after it until the settlement price is fixed; settled after that.

contracts.description: Signed contracts, up to 18 decimal places. Positive is a long.

side.description: long gains when the base strengthens against the dollar and the price rises.

notional_usdc.description: |contracts| × the contract size × mark_price, in USDC.

mark_price.description: The series' mark, in USDC per unit of the base. Once settled, the settlement price.

mark_updated_at.description: When the mark was set; once settled, when the series settled.

pending_vm_cngn.description: The same on the retired USDC-cNGN-30NOV26, in cNGN.

pending_vm_usdc.description: Variation margin accrued since the last settlement, in USDC. Positive is owed to the account.

FuturesAccount.description: Margin across the whole account. Absent when the account is under another manager.

manager.description: The MarginEngine the account is under.

im_surplus_usd.description: Initial-margin surplus in USD. Below zero, the account cannot open or add to a position.

mm_surplus_usd.description: Maintenance-margin surplus in USD. Below zero, the account is liquidated.

UnknownMarketResponse.description: The 400 from GET /book, GET /trades and GET /candles when the request names no listed market.

message.description: no such market: <identifier> when the symbol or asset_address + sub_id matched nothing; symbol or asset_address is required when the request named no market.

markets.description: The canonical identifiers the venue accepts, in listing order. Deprecated aliases are accepted but not listed.
